fire: We met for coffee on Prospect Avenue last Tuesday.
Old miners spent years prospecting along the river.
The prospect of a long winter worried the farmers.
Tourists stroll through Prospect Park on Sundays.
The club signed a young prospect from Brazil.
Companies now send bioprospectors into the rainforest.
Her prospects for promotion looked good this year.
The gold prospector built a cabin near the creek.
